### ✨ Monster Hunter Outlanders Mod Menu (v1.0.9)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Monster Hunter Outlanders** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (No Damage)** — Blocks incoming monster attacks & zeroes damage results
- **1-Hit Kill Monsters** — Instant monster elimination on hit
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Scales physical & elemental hit damage
- **Effective ATK Boost (`1x – 20x`)** — Multiplies hunter effective attack rating
- **Instant Part Break** — Forces instant monster part break on hit
- **Freeze Monster HP** — Locks monster HP change during combat

### 🛡️ Protection
- **1-User License**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
